front: When was the German Empire proclaimed, and where?
back: 18 January 1871, in the Hall of Mirrors at Versailles.
The king's report of his meeting with the French ambassador (13 July 1870), edited by Bismarck to sound insulting.
The offer of the Spanish throne to Prince Leopold of Hohenzollern-Sigmaringen (1870), opposed by France.

front: When did France declare war on Prussia?
What happened at Sedan in September 1870?
back: Napoleon III and his army surrendered; a republic was proclaimed in Paris on 4 September.

front: What did France lose by the Treaty of Frankfurt (10 May 1871)?
back: Alsace and much of Lorraine; it also paid 5 billion francs.
Napoleon III tried to buy Luxembourg; German opposition blocked it and it was made neutral.

front: Why did France's declaration of war help Bismarck?
back: The southern states' alliances applied only if Prussia was attacked, and France looked the aggressor.
Most historians see Bismarck as an opportunist with a clear aim who exploited events, backed by Prussian power.
